Qatar Energy LNG Field Operator Program Details

Qatar Energy LNG is seeking applications from talented professionals from Nigeria for exciting upcoming opportunities to support its operations in Qatar.

At QatarEnergy LNG, you will not only build a career with one of the world’s leading LNG companies, but also enjoy a competitive package that includes tax-free salary, housing, healthcare, and family support.

The recruitment drive specifically targets seasoned operations experts with backgrounds in Utility, Inlet Receiving, Sulphur Recovery, or LNG facilities for full-time employment in the oil and gas sector

Qatar Energy LNG Field Operator Program 2026 Benefits

The Qatar Energy LNG Field Operator Program offers the following benefits;

  • Career Opportunity

  • Tax-free base salary

  • Company-provided housing

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage

  • Family support and relocation benefits

  • Maintain the competency of all operational procedures and practices through on-the-job training and job rotation to ensure readiness and capability to assume the operator role.

  • Operate field equipment in accordance with operating and approved safety procedures to ensure effective process flows and optimum operational status of equipment.

  • Monitor and log all operating parameters ensuring that all irregularities are reported to immediate supervisor for advice and/or resolution.  

  • Prepare field equipment in allocated work area for maintenance activities and follow-up execution and recommission equipment upon satisfactory completion of work.

  • Ensure all Permit to Work requirements and expectations throughout Permit to Work issuance in the field and during PTW field audits.

  • Monitor all personnel and activities on site using, but limited to, unit surveillance, regular safety walks, audits and Observation Cards to ensure site safety and operational effectiveness.

  • Provide immediate first-line response capability in the event of emergencies or major incidents to eliminate or limit potential loss or damage to Company personnel, assets or the environment.

  • Ensure incoming shift operator is fully briefed on current operating status and significant events during previous shift to ensure seamless hand-over of responsibilities.

  • Collect all regular and special samples correctly as per schedule and direction of shift supervisor.

  • Perform electrical isolation and de-isolation work of low voltage electrical equipment in preparation of equipment for maintenance activities in line with approved procedure.

Qatar Energy LNG Field Operator Program Requirements

To be eligible for the Qatar Energy LNG Field Operator Program, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Completion of Secondary School  Education (12 years) + Vocational Training Certificate

  • 5 years of operator experience in Utility, Inlet Receiving, Sulphur Recovery, or LNG facilities

  • Your updated CV that clearly highlights:
